title: Venezuelan Vegetable Skewers
description: A crispy and herbal ovo-vegetarian friendly dish featuring galangal paste, katsuramuki-cut vegetables, and a salt block vessel, showcasing the flavors of Venezuela. This recipe is perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together galangal paste, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the katsuramuki-cut vegetables to the bowl and toss to coat with the galangal paste mixture.
Thread the vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the egg wash over the vegetables to help the bread crumbs adhere.
Roll the skewers in the bread crumbs to coat, pressing the crumbs onto the vegetables to help them stick.
Heat a salt block vessel over medium-high heat and add the skewers.
Cook the skewers for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the skewers to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
